005535: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_integer_expression_evaluate_with_features(Arena* arena, CSpellingSpace* space, CSymbolTable* symbols, CMacro* first_macro,
005536:                                                                      CPpStampTable* stamps, CPpToken* tokens, u32 token_count, u32 expansion_limit,
005537:                                                                      CPreprocessResult* result,
005538:                                                                      CPreprocessOptions* options, String8 including_path,
005539:                                                                      CIncludeSearchOrigin including_origin, u64* value_out)
005540: {
005541:     bool valid = true;
005542:     char8 const* base = space->base;
005543:     CPpToken* transformed = arena_allocate(arena, CPpToken, token_count);
005544:     u32 transformed_count = 0;
005545:     for (u32 token_index = 0; valid && token_index < token_count; token_index += 1)
005546:     {
005547:         CPpToken token = tokens[token_index];
005548:         if (token.token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && c_token_spelling_equal(base, token.token, S8("defined")))
005549:         {
005550:             u32 name_index = token_index + 1;
005551:             bool parenthesized = name_index < token_count && c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[name_index].token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS);
005552:             name_index += parenthesized;
005553:             if (name_index >= token_count || tokens[name_index].token.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
005554:             {
005555:                 valid = false;
005556:             }
005557:             else
005558:             {
005559:                 CMacro* macro = c_macro_find_token(first_macro, symbols, base, &tokens[name_index].token);
005560:                 CPpToken replacement = token;
005561:                 replacement.token.kind = C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER;
005562:                 replacement.token.punctuator = C_PUNCTUATOR_NONE;
005563:                 replacement.token.offset = macro && macro->definition.defined ? C_SPELLING_ONE : C_SPELLING_ZERO;
005564:                 replacement.token.length = 1;
005565:                 replacement.token.symbol = 0;
005566:                 transformed[transformed_count++] = replacement;
005567:                 token_index = name_index;
005568:                 if (parenthesized)
005569:                 {
005570:                     valid = token_index + 1 < token_count && c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[token_index + 1].token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
005571:                     token_index += 1;
005572:                 }
005573:             }
005574:         }
005575:         else
005576:         {
005577:             transformed[transformed_count++] = token;
005578:         }
005579:     }
005580:     CPreprocessTokenNode* first_expanded = 0;
005581:     CPreprocessTokenNode* last_expanded = 0;
005582:     u64 expanded_count = 0;
005583:     if (valid)
005584:     {

005586:                                     &last_expanded, &expanded_count, expansion_limit, result);
005587:     }
005588:     if (valid)
005589:     {
005590:         valid = c_conditional_feature_operators(arena, space, symbols, first_macro, first_expanded, options, including_path, including_origin);
005591:     }
005592:     if (valid)
005593:     {
005594:         u64* values = arena_allocate(arena, u64, expanded_count + 1);
005595:         u8* value_flags = arena_allocate(arena, u8, expanded_count + 1);
005596:         CConditionalOperator* operations = arena_allocate(arena, CConditionalOperator, expanded_count + 1);
005597:         u32 value_count = 0;
005598:         u32 operation_count = 0;
005599:         bool expect_operand = true;
005600:         for (CPreprocessTokenNode* node = first_expanded; valid && node; node = node->next)
005601:         {
005602:             CToken token = node->token.token;
005603:             if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER)
005604:             {
005605:                 u64 value = 0;
005606:                 String8 number_spelling = c_token_spelling(base, token);
005607:                 valid = expect_operand && c_conditional_number(number_spelling, &value);
005608:                 if (valid)
005609:                 {
005610:                     // The literal is uintmax_t when it says so or when its
005611:                     // value does not fit intmax_t. Characters and keywords
005612:                     // below remain signed regardless of their bit patterns.
005613:                     bool literal_unsigned = value > (u64)INT64_MAX;
005614:                     for (u64 suffix_index = 0; suffix_index < number_spelling.length; suffix_index += 1)
005615:                     {
005616:                         literal_unsigned |= number_spelling.pointer[suffix_index] == 'u' || number_spelling.pointer[suffix_index] == 'U';
005617:                     }
005618:                     value_flags[value_count] = literal_unsigned ? C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_UNSIGNED : 0;
005619:                     values[value_count++] = value;
005620:                     expect_operand = false;
005621:                 }
005622:             }
005623:             else if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_CHARACTER_LITERAL)
005624:             {
005625:                 u64 character = 0;
005626:                 CTypeKind character_kind = C_TYPE_INVALID;

005628:                 if (valid)
005629:                 {
005630:                     value_flags[value_count] = 0;
005631:                     values[value_count++] = character;
005632:                     expect_operand = false;
005633:                 }
005634:             }
005635:             else if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
005636:             {
005637:                 valid = expect_operand;
005638:                 if (valid)
005639:                 {
005640:                     value_flags[value_count] = 0;
005641:                     values[value_count++] = c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(result->dialect) && c_token_spelling_equal(base, token, S8("true"));
005642:                     expect_operand = false;
005643:                 }
005644:             }
005645:             else if (token.kind != C_TOKEN_PUNCTUATOR)
005646:             {
005647:                 valid = false;
005648:             }
005649:             else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
005650:             {
005651:                 valid = expect_operand;
005652:                 if (valid)
005653:                 {
005654:                     operations[operation_count++] = C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN;
005655:                 }
005656:             }
005657:             else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
005658:             {
005659:                 valid = !expect_operand;
005660:                 while (valid && operation_count && operations[operation_count - 1] != C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN)
005661:                 {
005662:                     valid = c_conditional_apply(operations[--operation_count], values, value_flags, &value_count);
005663:                 }
005664:                 valid = valid && operation_count != 0;
005665:                 if (valid)
005666:                 {
005667:                     operation_count -= 1;
005668:                 }
005669:             }
005670:             else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_QUESTION))
005671:             {
005672:                 valid = !expect_operand;
005673:                 u32 precedence = c_conditional_precedence(C_CONDITIONAL_QUESTION);
005674:                 while (valid && operation_count && operations[operation_count - 1] != C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN &&
005675:                        c_conditional_precedence(operations[operation_count - 1]) > precedence)
005676:                 {
005677:                     valid = c_conditional_apply(operations[--operation_count], values, value_flags, &value_count);
005678:                 }
005679:                 if (valid)
005680:                 {
005681:                     operations[operation_count++] = C_CONDITIONAL_QUESTION;
005682:                     expect_operand = true;
005683:                 }
005684:             }
005685:             else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_COLON))
005686:             {
005687:                 valid = !expect_operand;
005688:                 while (valid && operation_count && operations[operation_count - 1] != C_CONDITIONAL_QUESTION)
005689:                 {
005690:                     CConditionalOperator previous = operations[--operation_count];
005691:                     valid = previous != C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN && c_conditional_apply(previous, values, value_flags, &value_count);
005692:                 }
005693:                 valid = valid && operation_count != 0;
005694:                 if (valid)
005695:                 {
005696:                     operations[operation_count - 1] = C_CONDITIONAL_SELECT;
005697:                     expect_operand = true;
005698:                 }
005699:             }
005700:             else
005701:             {
005702:                 CConditionalOperator operation = C_CONDITIONAL_OPERATOR_COUNT;
005703:                 valid = c_conditional_operator(token, expect_operand, &operation);
005704:                 bool unary = c_conditional_is_unary(operation);
005705:                 valid = valid && expect_operand == unary;
005706:                 u32 precedence = c_conditional_precedence(operation);
005707:                 while (valid && operation_count && operations[operation_count - 1] != C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN)
005708:                 {
005709:                     CConditionalOperator previous = operations[operation_count - 1];
005710:                     u32 previous_precedence = c_conditional_precedence(previous);
005711:                     if (previous_precedence < precedence || (unary && previous_precedence == precedence))
005712:                     {
005713:                         break;
005714:                     }
005715:                     operation_count -= 1;
005716:                     valid = c_conditional_apply(previous, values, value_flags, &value_count);
005717:                 }
005718:                 if (valid)
005719:                 {
005720:                     operations[operation_count++] = operation;
005721:                     expect_operand = true;
005722:                 }
005723:             }
005724:         }
005725:         valid = valid && !expect_operand;
005726:         while (valid && operation_count)
005727:         {
005728:             CConditionalOperator operation = operations[--operation_count];
005729:             valid = operation != C_CONDITIONAL_OPEN && operation != C_CONDITIONAL_QUESTION &&
005730:                     c_conditional_apply(operation, values, value_flags, &value_count);
005731:         }
005732:         valid = valid && value_count == 1 && !(value_flags[0] & C_CONDITIONAL_VALUE_FAULT);
005733:         if (valid)
005734:         {
005735:             *value_out = values[0];
005736:         }
005737:     }
005738:     return valid;
005739: }

005741: // The parse-side entry point: no macro table, so expansion is a pass-through
005742: // and nothing ever allocates spelling bytes — the read-only space view over
005743: // the finished result is enough, and any allocation attempt fails loudly.
005744: BUSTER_C_SHARED bool c_integer_expression_evaluate(Arena* arena, char8 const* spelling_base, CToken* tokens, u32 token_count, u32 expansion_limit,
005745:                                                        CPreprocessResult* result, u64* value_out)
005746: {
005747:     CSpellingSpace view = {
005748:         .base = (char8*)spelling_base,
005749:     };
005750:     CPpToken* wrapped = arena_allocate(arena, CPpToken, token_count);
005751:     for (u32 token_index = 0; token_index < token_count; token_index += 1)
005752:     {
005753:         wrapped[token_index] = (CPpToken){
005754:             .token = tokens[token_index],
005755:         };
005756:     }
005757:     return c_integer_expression_evaluate_with_features(arena, &view, 0, 0, 0, wrapped, token_count, expansion_limit, result, 0, (String8){0},
005758:                                                        (CIncludeSearchOrigin){0}, value_out);
005759: }

005764: {

005769:     *value_out = value != 0;
005770:     return valid;

005789: // The row scan the mask projection below replaces, kept as the definition of
005790: // a line's end for a run that carries no shape sidecar and as the reference
005791: // c_test_pp_class_masks_agree holds the mask path to.
005792: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u64 c_preprocess_line_end(CLexResult lex, u64 token_index)
005793: {
005794:     while (token_index < lex.token_count && lex.tokens[token_index].kind != C_TOKEN_NEWLINE && lex.tokens[token_index].kind != C_TOKEN_END_OF_FILE)
005795:     {
005796:         token_index += 1;
005797:     }
005798:     return token_index;
005799: }
005800: 
005801: // The per-64-token class projection of one lexed run, built once when the run
005802: // becomes a source frame and read by every per-line scan of the driver below.
005803: //
005804: // Every one of those scans asks the same closed set of questions of a token —
005805: // does the line end here, is this a parenthesis, can this name a macro — and
005806: // the one-byte shape sidecar answers all of them without touching a 12-byte
005807: // row, so 64 tokens are one masked load and four compares. What that buys is
005808: // not the compare but the advance: a line end becomes a trailing-zero count
005809: // instead of a nine-step row loop with a mispredicted exit, and the
005810: // parenthesis and macro-name scans visit only the lanes that can answer
005811: // (12% and 20% of the stream on this workload) instead of every token of
005812: // every line. C_TOKEN_INVALID is 0, so the masked tail lanes of the last
005813: // window match no class and need no separate trim.
005814: #define C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW 64
005815: 
005816: typedef struct CPpClassMasks CPpClassMasks;
005817: struct CPpClassMasks
005818: {
005819:     Mask64* stop;
005820:     Mask64* identifier;
005821:     Mask64* parenthesis_left;
005822:     Mask64* parenthesis_right;
005823:     // 0 when the run carried no shape sidecar; every consumer falls back to
005824:     // the row scans above on that run.
005825:     u64 word_count;
005826: };
005827: 
005828: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_pp_class_masks_build(Arena* arena, CPpClassMasks* masks, CTokenShape const* shapes, u64 token_count)
005829: {
005830:     u64 word_count = (token_count + (C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW - 1)) / C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW;
005831:     *masks = (CPpClassMasks){0};
005832:     if (shapes && word_count)
005833:     {
005834:         masks->stop = arena_allocate(arena, Mask64, word_count);
005835:         masks->identifier = arena_allocate(arena, Mask64, word_count);
005836:         masks->parenthesis_left = arena_allocate(arena, Mask64, word_count);
005837:         masks->parenthesis_right = arena_allocate(arena, Mask64, word_count);
005838:         Simd512 newline_shape = simd512_splat((u8)C_TOKEN_NEWLINE);
005839:         Simd512 end_shape = simd512_splat((u8)C_TOKEN_END_OF_FILE);
005840:         Simd512 identifier_shape = simd512_splat((u8)C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER);
005841:         Simd512 left_shape = simd512_splat(c_token_shape_from_fields(C_TOKEN_PUNCTUATOR, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS));
005842:         Simd512 right_shape = simd512_splat(c_token_shape_from_fields(C_TOKEN_PUNCTUATOR, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS));
005843:         for (u64 word_index = 0; word_index < word_count; word_index += 1)
005844:         {
005845:             u64 window_base = word_index * C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW;
005846:             Mask64 window_mask = mask64_prefix(token_count - window_base);
005847:             Simd512 window = simd512_load_masked(shapes + window_base, window_mask);
005848:             masks->stop[word_index] = mask64_or(simd512_equal_byte(window, newline_shape), simd512_equal_byte(window, end_shape));
005849:             masks->identifier[word_index] = simd512_equal_byte(window, identifier_shape);
005850:             masks->parenthesis_left[word_index] = simd512_equal_byte(window, left_shape);
005851:             masks->parenthesis_right[word_index] = simd512_equal_byte(window, right_shape);
005852:         }
005853:         masks->word_count = word_count;
005854:     }
005855: }
005856: 
005857: // The lanes of `word_index` that lie in [first, end): the whole word except
005858: // at the two ends of the range.
005859: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL Mask64 c_pp_class_range_mask(u64 word_index, u64 first, u64 end)
005860: {
005861:     Mask64 result = mask64_not(0);
005862:     if (word_index == first / C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW)
005863:     {
005864:         result = mask64_and(result, mask64_shift_left(mask64_not(0), first % C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW));
005865:     }
005866:     if (word_index == (end - 1) / C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW)
005867:     {
005868:         result = mask64_and(result, mask64_prefix(((end - 1) % C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW) + 1));
005869:     }
005870:     return result;
005871: }
005872: 
005873: // The first newline or end-of-file token at or after `token_index`, which is
005874: // what c_preprocess_line_end answers by walking rows.
005875: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u64 c_pp_line_end_masked(CPpClassMasks const* masks, u64 token_count, u64 token_index)
005876: {
005877:     u64 result = token_count;
005878:     if (token_index < token_count)
005879:     {
005880:         u64 word_index = token_index / C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW;
005881:         Mask64 pending = mask64_and(masks->stop[word_index], mask64_shift_left(mask64_not(0), token_index % C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW));
005882:         while (!pending && word_index + 1 < masks->word_count)
005883:         {
005884:             word_index += 1;
005885:             pending = masks->stop[word_index];
005886:         }
005887:         if (pending)
005888:         {
005889:             result = word_index * C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW + mask64_first_set(pending);
005890:         }
005891:     }
005892:     return result;
005893: }
005894: 
005895: // The clamped parenthesis depth after [first, end), entered at `depth`: a
005896: // ')' with nothing open is ignored, which is what the row scan did.
005897: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_pp_parenthesis_depth(CPpClassMasks const* masks, u64 first, u64 end, u32 depth)
005898: {
005899:     u32 result = depth;
005900:     if (first < end)
005901:     {
005902:         u64 last_word = (end - 1) / C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW;
005903:         for (u64 word_index = first / C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW; word_index <= last_word; word_index += 1)
005904:         {
005905:             Mask64 range = c_pp_class_range_mask(word_index, first, end);
005906:             Mask64 opens = mask64_and(masks->parenthesis_left[word_index], range);
005907:             Mask64 closes = mask64_and(masks->parenthesis_right[word_index], range);
005908:             Mask64 pending = mask64_or(opens, closes);
005909:             while (pending)
005910:             {
005911:                 u32 lane = mask64_first_set(pending);
005912:                 bool opening = mask64_and(mask64_shift_right(opens, lane), 1) != 0;
005913:                 result = opening ? result + 1 : (result ? result - 1 : 0);
005914:                 pending = mask64_and(pending, pending - 1);
005915:             }
005916:         }
005917:     }
005918:     return result;
005919: }
005920: 
005921: #if BUSTER_INCLUDE_TESTS
005922: // The differential gate on the mask projection: every answer the driver takes
005923: // from a mask must equal the row scan it replaced, on a run whose lines cross
005924: // the 64-token windows at every offset.
005925: bool c_test_pp_class_masks_agree(Arena* arena, String8 source)
005926: {
005927:     bool result = true;
005928:     CLexResult lex = c_lex(arena, source);
005929:     CPpClassMasks masks;
005930:     c_pp_class_masks_build(arena, &masks, lex.token_shapes, lex.token_count);
005931:     if (!masks.word_count && lex.token_count)
005932:     {
005933:         result = false;
005934:     }
005935:     for (u64 token_index = 0; result && token_index < lex.token_count; token_index += 1)
005936:     {
005937:         Mask64 word = masks.identifier[token_index / C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW];
005938:         bool named = mask64_and(mask64_shift_right(word, token_index % C_PP_CLASS_MASK_WINDOW), 1) != 0;
005939:         if (named != (lex.tokens[token_index].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER))
005940:         {
005941:             result = false;
005942:         }
005943:         if (c_pp_line_end_masked(&masks, lex.token_count, token_index) != c_preprocess_line_end(lex, token_index))
005944:         {
005945:             result = false;
005946:         }
005947:     }
005948:     for (u64 line_start = 0; result && line_start < lex.token_count;)
005949:     {
005950:         u64 line_end = c_preprocess_line_end(lex, line_start);
005951:         u32 rows = 0;
005952:         for (u64 scan = line_start; scan < line_end; scan += 1)
005953:         {
005954:             if (c_token_is_punctuator(&lex.tokens[scan], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
005955:             {
005956:                 rows += 1;
005957:             }
005958:             else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&lex.tokens[scan], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) && rows)
005959:             {
005960:                 rows -= 1;
005961:             }
005962:         }
005963:         if (c_pp_parenthesis_depth(&masks, line_start, line_end, 0) != rows)
005964:         {
005965:             result = false;
005966:         }
005967:         line_start = line_end + 1;
005968:     }
005969:     return result;
005970: }
005971: #endif
005972: 
005973: // The whole-file include-guard proof, per source frame: SEARCHING until the
005974: // file's first top-level directive, GUARDED while inside a leading
005975: // `#ifndef NAME` conditional, CLOSED once its `#endif` returns to the
005976: // frame's base with the shape still intact, and DISQUALIFIED as soon as any
005977: // token or directive is seen at the frame's top level outside that one
005978: // conditional. A frame that reaches end of file CLOSED has proven that
005979: // re-lexing it while NAME is defined can only produce an empty token
005980: // sequence, which is what lets the next inclusion be dropped unread.
005981: typedef enum CIncludeGuardState
005982: {
005983:     C_INCLUDE_GUARD_SEARCHING = 0,
005984:     C_INCLUDE_GUARD_GUARDED,
005985:     C_INCLUDE_GUARD_CLOSED,
005986:     C_INCLUDE_GUARD_DISQUALIFIED,
005987: } CIncludeGuardState;
005988: 
005989: typedef struct CPreprocessSourceFrame CPreprocessSourceFrame;
005990: struct CPreprocessSourceFrame
005991: {
005992:     CPreprocessSourceFrame* previous;
005993:     CConditionalFrame* conditional_base;
005994:     // The leading top-level conditional while the guard proof is GUARDED,
005995:     // and the interned symbol of its `#ifndef` name (see CIncludeGuardState).
005996:     CConditionalFrame* guard;
005997:     CLexResult lex;
005998:     // The class projection of `lex` (see CPpClassMasks); built once when the
005999:     // frame is pushed, read by every per-line scan of the driver.
006000:     CPpClassMasks class_masks;
006001:     String8 path;
006002:     // Suppression keys are deliberately separate from diagnostic/source-map
006003:     // spellings. Filesystem frames carry descriptor identity while the resolved
006004:     // path remains what diagnostics and source maps show.
